finalText:
**Redis went down and took the whole service with it.**

```
02:14:07  redis refuses connections at 10.0.0.12:6379
02:14:08  cache bypassed, every read goes straight to the store
02:14:10  store overloads, requests time out after 5000ms
02:29:12  request queue passes its own 500 limit
02:31:44  worker-2 dies, JavaScript heap out of memory
02:31:52  supervisor kills the process group, service down
```

The trigger was `redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`.
It retried 13 times over 16 minutes. Every try failed the same way.
No request succeeded after 02:14:03. That is nearly 18 minutes fully down.

What made it fatal: the app kept accepting requests it could not serve.
The queue blew past its own 500 cap. Then memory ran out.

Next: find why redis stopped listening on `10.0.0.12`. Then make the app
turn requests away once the queue fills.
